Subject: Request: bridge letter to cover period after SOC 2 report end date

Hi Irene and Marissa —

Thanks again for the SOC 2 report you provided. Our audit team at Asteria is evaluating coverage through to our contract renewal and needs a short bridge letter (or interim affirmation) that covers the period from the report end date (2026-12-31) to the current date.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
- Provide a bridge letter that affirms no material changes in the control environment relevant to our use of the service since 2026-12-31, or
- If not, provide a short statement describing the controls that changed and corrective actions underway.

We also need an evidence delivery plan so the auditors can map any newly requested artifacts. Preferred timeline: countersigned bridge letter by 2027-04-20, and an evidence handoff (if needed) by 2027-04-25.

For context, BrightAudit (copied) will be the external assessor coordinating the request. Please let us know: 1) who will sign the bridge letter, 2) if you need any specific evidence from our side, and 3) whether we should expect a one-page letter vs. a short memo.

Appreciate a quick confirmation of next steps.

Best,
Emma Ruiz

Thanks for the clear ask. We can provide a short bridge letter that affirms the control posture for the audit scope and notes whether any reportable exceptions occurred since 2026-12-31. To be explicit: we aim for a one-page bridgenote signed by our Head of Compliance (or delegated signer).

Action items for our side:
- I will prepare a draft bridgenote and share it for your review by EOD 2027-04-12.
- Karthik, Jordan — can one of you confirm whether the controls matrix has any late changes in Q1 2027 that would need mention? If yes, we will include a short description and mitigation timeline.
- Marissa — can you confirm who is authorized to sign (Head of Compliance vs. VP Security) and whether Legal wants any specific language about limitations?

Emma, for the evidence plan: please advise whether BrightAudit wants the full evidence set or only items referencing the last-quarter changes (if any). If you can provide a list of specific artifacts, we will stage them in a shared drive and provide index.xlsx.

We will attach the draft bridgenote and a preliminary controls evidence index in my next message.
